title.zh: GPT-6 Astra has gained the ability to drive a car
title.en: GPT-6 Astra has gained the ability to drive a car

current_state.zh: A driving benchmark demonstrates GPT-6 Astra completing an end-to-end driving route from visual input to steering control, prompting debate over whether LLM-based driving stacks will displace modular self-driving architectures and whether latency makes real-world deployment infeasible.
